Let a client triage bad property data into coding tasks
Building a desktop work/coding agent so a nonprofit client can inspect malformed Entrata/Yardi/Excel files, generate tasks for review, and email property managers about missing data.
·
Nov 9, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
CL
Claude
What they did
The author, a remote consultant, maintains software for a nonprofit that manages property tax exemption compliance for 70+ property managers using Entrata, Yardi, or custom Excel. He is building a desktop work/coding agent so the client can inspect problem files, generate coding tasks for his review, and email property managers about missing data. A hosted backend would handle users, permissions, and tasks.
How it went
Nothing has shipped yet. The source describes a plan in progress, with no results or numbers, and hopes it grows into a broader AI product for property managers within a couple of years.
Worth knowing
The client already uses Claude desktop and a Google Sheet for bugs and feature requests, so the agent builds on an existing workflow.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
I've put exports from our property management system in [folder path], including [Entrata, Yardi, or Excel files]. Go through each file and flag malformed or missing data, such as [blank unit numbers, bad dates, missing rent amounts], then write a task list with one item per problem group, naming the file, row, and suggested fix. Also draft a short email to each property manager listing only the missing data for their properties. Stop once the task list and email drafts are saved in [output folder], and do not send any emails or change the original files; show me the drafts first.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50420299
